issue.title: (AgentCore) Error: The terraform-provider-aws_v6.48.0_x5 plugin crashed!
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
Terraform v1.14.9
on linux_amd64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/datadog/datadog v3.91.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v6.48.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/local v2.9.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

Unclear, all AgentCore resources appear to have been created successfully looking at AWS Console.

- Runtime
- Gateway (MCP) + 1 Target
- Short Term Memory

### Expected Behavior

Apply cleanly without errors.

### Actual Behavior

Plugin did not respond error, and plugin crashed message: `terraform-provider-aws_v6.48.0_x5 plugin crashed`
